children: Silver47 reported a $10.13 million net loss for the year ended July 31, 2025 and $4.84 million cash at year-end, and disclosed a subsequent Summa acquisition.
Audited FY2025 results: net loss of $10,130,666 vs $4,519,965 in FY2024, raising going-concern uncertainty.
Year-end cash of $4,843,916 (July 31, 2025); operating cash outflow was $8,535,798 for FY2025.
Exploration spend rose to $4,695,295 in FY2025, driving total operating expenses of $10.27M.
Equity increased: share capital $27,424,699 and total equity $13,788,527 at July 31, 2025.
Post-period: completed acquisition of Summa on Aug 1, 2025 and significant financings boosting cash to ~$49.0M by Apr 30, 2026.
